h1: Custom 18 oz Koozies for Events & Giveaways
metaDescription: Order custom 18 oz koozies for your next event. Perfect for cans & bottles. Fast turnaround & bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 18 oz koozies are sized to fit standard beverage cans and bottles snugly, keeping drinks cold longer during outdoor events, trade shows, or employee appreciation days. Unlike generic one-size options, these koozies offer a tailored fit that prevents slipping and provides consistent insulation. Choose from neoprene or foam materials, and add your logo with screen printing or full-color sublimation for a polished, professional look that stands out in a crowd.
heroAltText: Custom 18 oz koozies with company logo printed on neoprene, keeping drinks cold at an outdoor event
